home.subtitle: Guide
home.tagline: We are with you on your Hajj journey: tasks, guidance, and a multilingual interface.
home.body: After you complete your profile, you can follow tasks in your chosen language. With Arabic, the layout uses right-to-left text. New sections will be added through the same translation files as the app grows.

anaGorev.task2: Main task 2: ARRIVAL IN MAKKAH & TAWĀF AL-QUDŪM

arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: After sunrise, travel to ʿArafāt
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Perform ghusl before the time of the sun at its zenith (before ẓuhr)
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Perform Ẓuhr and ʿAṣr in combined (jamʿ) form — jamʿ al-taqdīm
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Stand in waqf toward the qiblah, in supplication and dhikr
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: After each prayer, recite the takbīr of tashrīq
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step6: 6. Step: When the sun has set, travel to Muzdalifah; do not leave (ʿArafāt) early

arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.dua: Allāhumma ilayka tawajjahtu wa bika iʿtaṣamtu fa-thabbitnī bi al-ḥabli alladhī lā yanfaṣim
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.meaning: O Allah! I turn to You and hold fast to You. Bind me with the unfailing bond (cable that never breaks).
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.talbiyeNote: The talbiyah is continued on the way to ʿArafāt.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note1: 📅 9 dhū al-Ḥijjah — the Day of ʿArafah: leave after sunrise.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note2: 📍 ʿArafāt is about 25 km south-east of Makkah.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note3: ⚠️ The time of the waqf (standing) is from the sun’s zenith to sunset on this day.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note4: 🏔️ It is especially virtuous to be near Jabal al-Raḥmah (the Mount of Mercy) for the waqf.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note5: 🤲 This is the greatest pillar of Ḥajj — be present with your whole heart.

arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.niyet: I intend to perform ghusl. O Allah, purify me from my sins.
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.g2: 2️⃣ Wash the hands up to the wrists
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.g5: 5️⃣ Pour water over the head three times, wetting the hair thoroughly
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.g6: 6️⃣ Wash the rest of the body, starting on the right shoulder, then the left
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.note1: ⏰ It is done before the time of the sun at its zenith (before the ḍuhr period).
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.note2: 🤍 This ghusl symbolises purification before the waqf (standing at ʿArafah).
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.note3: 💧 If a full ghusl is not possible, wuḍūʾ (ritual ablution) is enough.
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.note4: ✨ As you purify the body, turn the heart to Allah and seek forgiveness of sins.

arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.sequenceTitle: How the prayers are performed (in order):
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.s1: 1️⃣ The adhān of Ẓuhr is called
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.s2: 2️⃣ The regular sunnah of Ẓuhr is offered
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.s3: 3️⃣ With iqāmah, the fard of Ẓuhr (2 rakʿahs, qaṣr) is prayed
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.s4: 4️⃣ Then iqāmah and the fard of ʿAṣr (2 rakʿahs, qaṣr) — jamʿ with taqdīm
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.warning: ⚠️ No sunnah between the two fard, and the adhān is not called between them
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.note1: 🕌 The two prayers are combined in advance ((jamʿ) al-taqdīm) at ʿArafah.
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.note2: 📍 In congregation, ideally at Masjid Namirah if possible; it may be prayed in the tent.
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.note3: 🤲 Begin the waqf (standing) right after the prayer; do not spend this time in vain.

arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.bestTitle: The most virtuous supplication at ʿArafah:
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.bestDua: Lā ilāha illallāh waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.bestMeaning: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the kingdom, to Him is all praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.vakfeDua: Allāhumma innaka tasmau kalāmī wa tarā makanī wa ta'lamu sirrī wa 'alānīyatī, lā yakhfa' alayka shay'un min amrī
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.vakfeMeaning: O Allah! You hear my words, You see my place, You know my inward and my outward. Nothing of my state is hidden from You.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note1: 🕌 One stands turned toward the qiblah, with the hands raised.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note2: 😢 Sincere weeping, humility, and repentance are among the greatest acts of this moment.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note3: 🤲 Supplicate for yourself, your parents, and all the believers.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note4: ⏰ The waqf is from the sun’s zenith to sunset of this day.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note5: 🏔️ The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Ḥajj is ʿArafah” (the standing here is the great pillar of Ḥajj).

arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.title: Takbīr of al-tashrīq (the tashrīq formula):
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.translit: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, lā ilāha illallāh wa Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar wa lillāhi al-ḥamd
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.meaning: Allāh is the Greatest, Allāh is the Greatest. There is no god but Allāh, and Allāh is the Greatest, Allāh is the Greatest. To Allāh belongs all praise.
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note1: 📅 It begins from the Fajr of the Day of ʿArafah (ʿArafah morning).
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note2: 📅 It continues until the ʿAṣr of the fourth day of ʿEid (al-tashrīq days).
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note3: 🕌 After each fard, once after the salām — one full recitation of the formula.
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note4: 👩 Women recite quietly, without raising the voice.
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note5: 🔢 It follows the 23 fard ṣalāh of this period (once after each of those fard, as counted in common teaching).

arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.dua: Allāhumma bika āmantu wa ʿalayka tawakkaltu wa ilayka anabtu wa bika ḥāṣamtu wa anta Rabbī
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.meaning: O Allah! In You I have believed, on You I have relied, to You I have turned, with You I seek strength, and You are my Lord.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note1: ⏰ Travel begins only after the sun has fully set; early departure (before ʿArafah is over) is not valid for the waqf.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note2: ⚠️ Having been in ʿArafah by day and leaving before sunset makes a expiation (dam by sacrifice) required in the classical ruling.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note3: 🚌 On the way, engage in talbiyah, takbīr, and supplication.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note4: 🌙 Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ are offered together (jamʿ) at Muzdalifah; they are not performed on the road.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note5: 📍 Muzdalifah is between ʿArafāt and Minā, roughly 9 km.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.title: WAQF AT MUZDALIFAH
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Perform Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ in combination (jamʿ) — jamʿ al-taʾkhīr
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Spend the night at Muzdalifah and perform the waqf (obligatory)
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Spend the night in dhikr, supplication, and istighfār
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Gather 49 or 70 small pebbles for stoning
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Perform Fajr and the post-dawn waqf supplication
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step6: 6. Step: Travel to Minā before sunrise

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.title: 1. Step: Perform Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ in combination (jamʿ) — jamʿ al-taʾkhīr
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.body: After reaching Muzdalifah on the evening of ʿArafah, Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ are offered here as jamʿ al-taʾkhīr (combined with delay): in the well-known arrangement, the iqāmah is for the full ʿIshāʾ, then Maghrib is prayed, then ʿIshāʾ is completed. These prayers are not performed on the way; follow your reliable guide and the imām. Talbiyah continues until you intend to leave it, and is typically left before the prayers at this point.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.title: 2. Step: Spend the night at Muzdalifah and perform the waqf (obligatory)
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.body: Spending the night (mabit) in Muzdalifah and performing a short standing (waqf) within its limits—often from Fajr or in the latter part of the night—is obligatory (wājib). Stay in permitted, safe areas and observe crowd safety.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.title: 3. Step: Spend the night in dhikr, supplication, and istighfār
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.body: It is recommended to spend the Muzdalifah night in takbīr, tasbīḥ, Qurʾān recitation, istighfār, and duʿāʾ. Try to be awake before Fajr unless you have a valid excuse; follow the manners (ādab) of this night.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.title: 4. Step: Gather 49 or 70 small pebbles for stoning
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.body: For stoning at Minā you need small pebbles about the size of a date stone. In many Ḥanafī arrangements, 49 are used; some teachings refer to 70. Collect them at Muzdalifah or along the way at a suitable, safe spot; keep the environment and other pilgrims in mind.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.title: 5. Step: Perform Fajr and the post-dawn waqf supplication
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.body: At Muzdalifah, Fajr is performed after true dawn (al-fajr al-ṣādiq) and before sunrise. It is sunnah to reserve time after dawn and before sunrise for the waqf duʿāʾ and earnest supplication; details can follow your school and guide.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.title: 6. Step: Travel to Minā before sunrise
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.body: In general, pilgrims move toward Minā before the sun rises (before shurūq), using the route and schedule set by authorities or your group. Avoid crowding and plan your departure; do not delay needlessly until after sunrise without need.

ihramAdimlar.title: Our steps
ihramAdimlar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Complete the required body cleaning.
ihramAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Put on the Ihram clothing.
ihramAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Pray 2 rak'ahs of the Ihram prayer.
ihramAdimlar.step7: 7. Step: Learn and observe the Ihram prohibitions

minaGecelemeAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Go to Minā (8 dhū al-Ḥijjah, after sunrise)
minaGecelemeAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Perform Ẓuhr, ʿAṣr, Maghrib, ʿIshāʾ, and Fajr in Minā (two rakʿahs each; not combined [jamʿ])
minaGecelemeAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Pass the night in worship with dhikr, supplication, and recitation of the Qurʾān
minaGecelemeAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Remain the night in Minā (a confirmed sunnah)

minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.dua: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.meaning: In the name of Allah I place my trust in Allah; there is no might nor power except with Allah.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.talbiye: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.talbiyeNote: The talbiyah is continued on the way to Minā.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note1: 📅 On the morning of 8 dhū al-Ḥijjah, one departs after sunrise.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note2: 📍 Minā lies in a valley between Makkah and ʿArafāt.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note3: 🚶 Walking is sunnah; going by vehicle is also permitted.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note4: ⏰ One stays in Minā until the Fajr of the Day of ʿArafah.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note5: 🕌 Those performing tamattuʿ enter ihram again for Hajj on this day.

minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.important1: 🕌 In Minā, prayers are performed in shortened (qaṣr) form.
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.important2: That is, the four-rakʿah prayers are offered as two rakʿahs.
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.important3: But each prayer is at its own time; prayers are not combined (jamʿ).
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.note1: ⏰ Each prayer is on time; it is not brought forward or delayed beyond its time.
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.note2: 🤲 Between prayers, occupy yourself with dhikr, supplication, and the talbiyah.
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.note3: 📍 If possible, pray at Masjid al-Khayf; praying in the tent is also valid.

minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.zikir4: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ — 1 time
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.nightDua: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رَحْمَتَكَ وَمَغْفِرَتَكَ وَرِضْوَاكَ وَالْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَعُقُوبَتِكَ وَمِنَ النَّارِ
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.meaning: O Allah! I ask You for Your mercy, Your forgiveness, Your good pleasure, and Paradise. I seek refuge in You from Your anger, Your punishment, and from the Fire.
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.note1: 📖 Recite the Qurʾān; it is especially virtuous to recite Sūrah al-Baqarah and Āl ʿImrān.
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.note2: 🤲 The supplications of this night are very precious; supplicate with sincerity.
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.note3: 🌙 Tomorrow is the standing at ʿArafāt — the greatest moment approaches.
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.note4: 😴 Rest is also an act of devotion; sleep to be strong for the day ahead.

minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.importance1: The Prophet (ﷺ) spent the night in Minā and made this a sunnah.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.importance2: This is the night of preparation for the great moment at ʿArafāt.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.nightDua: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika amsaynā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilayka al-maṣīr
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.meaning: O Allah! By You we enter the morning and the evening, by You we live and die, and to You is the return.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.note1: 📍 You must pass the night within the boundaries of Minā; do not go outside them.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.note2: 🌙 Tomorrow is 9 dhū al-Ḥijjah — the Day of ʿArafah, the greatest pillar of Ḥajj.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.note3: 😴 Rest well: a long and blessed day awaits you tomorrow.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.note4: 🤲 Before sleep, supplicate and give thanks to Allah.

kudumAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Recite the supplication for entering al-Masjid al-Ḥarām
kudumAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Greet the Black Stone (Ḥajar al-Aswad) and intend the ṭawāf
kudumAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Perform seven circuits of ṭawāf around the Kaʿbah
kudumAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Greet the Yemeni Corner (Rukn al-Yamanī) each circuit
kudumAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Perform two rakʿas of ṭawāf prayer at Maqām Ibrāhīm

kudumAdim1Mescid.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim1Mescid.dua: Allāhumma anta al-salām wa minka al-salām, fa hayyinā Rabbanā bi al-salām
kudumAdim1Mescid.meaning: O Allah! You are As-Salām, and safety is from You. Keep us alive, our Lord, in safety (salvation).
kudumAdim1Mescid.note: 📍 Enter with the right foot at the gate of al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and recite this supplication.

kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.niyet: I intend to perform ṭawāf — O Allah, accept it from me.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.meaning: In the name of Allah — Allah is the Greatest.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note1: 📍 The Black Stone is at the eastern corner of the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note2: 🤲 If possible it is kissed; if crowded, greet it from a distance by raising the hand.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note3: ⚠️ Do it without harming anyone; no pushing or forcing.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note4: 🔄 At each circuit, when you reach the Black Stone, greet it again.

kudumAdim3Tavaf7.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.dua: Subḥān Allāhi wa al-ḥamdu lillāhi wa lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.yemaniHacerLabel: Between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone:
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.yemaniHacer: Rabbanā ātinā fī al-dunyā ḥasanah wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā ʿadhāb al-nār
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note1: 🔄 Ṭawāf begins at the Black Stone, with the Kaʿbah on your left.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note2: 🕋 Walk outside the Ḥāṭim; do not go through the inside (the semi-circle).
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note3: 🚶 Men perform ramal (brisk, shoulder-rolling walk) in the first three rounds.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note4: 👆 In each round, touch the Yemeni Corner, and salute the Black Stone.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note5: 🚫 Do not recite the talbiyah while performing ṭawāf.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note6: 👩 Women do not raise their voices, and it is good to do ṭawāf in a less crowded area if possible.

kudumAdim4RuknYemani.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenLabel: Supplication between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone:
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenArabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenLatin: Rabbanā ātinā fī al-dunyā ḥasanah wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā ʿadhāb al-nār
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenMeaning: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note1: 📍 Rukn al-Yamanī is at the south-western corner of the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note2: 🤲 If possible, greet with the hand; it is not kissed.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note3: ↔️ Greeting from a distance is enough; you do not have to push or strain.

kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.ayetLabel: Verse to reflect on before the prayer:
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.ayetMeaning: And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Ibrāhīm a place of prayer. (Qurʾan 2:125)
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note1: 📍 If possible, pray behind Maqām Ibrāhīm.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note2: 👥 If crowded, the prayer may be offered anywhere in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note3: ⏰ It is not performed at the disliked (karāhah) times.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note4: 🤲 After the prayer, face the Kaʿbah and supplicate.

kudumAdim6Zemzem.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileLatin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka ʿilman nāfiʿan wa rizqan wāsiʿan wa shifā'an min kulli dā'
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileMeaning: O Allah! I ask You for beneficial knowledge, ample provision, and healing from every disease.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note1: 🕋 It is recommended standing, facing the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note2: 💧 Drink plenty, but do not waste.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note3: 🤲 Afterwards one makes a personal supplication; this is a very precious time.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note4: ✨ It is authentically reported that Zamzam is for whatever intention it is drunk for (hadith).

sayAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Go up to Safa and form the intention for saʿy
sayAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Face the Kaʿbah, say the takbīr, tahlīl, and supplicate
sayAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Walk from Safa toward Marwah (men may walk briskly at the green lights)
sayAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: At Marwah, turn toward the Kaʿbah and say the takbīr and supplicate
sayAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Continue until 7 rounds are complete (4 outward + 3 return legs)
sayAdimlar.step6: 6. Step: At Marwah, complete the supplication as appropriate

sayAdim1Safa.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim1Safa.ayetArabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
sayAdim1Safa.ayetMeaning: Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. (Qurʾan 2:158)
sayAdim1Safa.niyet: O Allah! I intend to perform saʿy for Your sake. Make it easy for me and accept it from me.
sayAdim1Safa.note1: 📍 Saʿy begins at Ṣafā and ends at Marwah.
sayAdim1Safa.note2: 🕋 Open the hands, say the takbīr and tahlīl, while facing the Kaʿbah.
sayAdim1Safa.note3: 🔢 One round (shaṭṭ) is Ṣafā → Marwah; the next is Marwah → Ṣafā.
sayAdim1Safa.note4: 🏃 Men may run (harwalah) in the marked section; women walk normally.

sayAdim2Tekbir.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim2Tekbir.tekbir: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar
sayAdim2Tekbir.tehlil: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr
sayAdim2Tekbir.tehlilMeaning: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
sayAdim2Tekbir.dua: Allāhumma innaka qulta wa daʿawnī fastajibtu lakum, wa innaka lā tukhliful-mīʿād
sayAdim2Tekbir.duaMeaning: O Allah! You said ‘Call upon Me, I will answer you’ — and You do not break Your promise.
sayAdim2Tekbir.note1: 🕋 Facing the Kaʿbah, open the hands to shoulder level.
sayAdim2Tekbir.note2: 🔄 This supplication is done at Ṣafā and on each turn at Marwah.
sayAdim2Tekbir.note3: 👩 Women recite quietly without raising the voice.

sayAdim3SafaMerve.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim3SafaMerve.dua: Rabb ighfir warḥam wa-tajāwaz ʿammā taʿlamu innaka anta l-aʿazzu l-akram
sayAdim3SafaMerve.duaMeaning: My Lord! Forgive, have mercy, and pardon what You know. Surely You are the Most Mighty, the Most Generous.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note1: 🚶 While walking, one keeps busy with takbīr, tahlīl, and supplication.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note2: 🏃 Men run with ramal in the green-lit area between the markers.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note3: 👩 Women walk normally, even in the green-lit area; they do not run.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note4: 📏 The distance between Ṣafā and Marwah is about 400 metres.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note5: ➡️ From Ṣafā to Marwah is the first leg (al-shaṭṭ al-awwal).

sayAdim4Merve.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim4Merve.tekbirLine: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar
sayAdim4Merve.tehlilLine: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah
sayAdim4Merve.dua: Allāhumma innaka qulta udʿūnī astajib lakum, wa innaka lā tukhliful-mīʿād
sayAdim4Merve.duaMeaning: O Allah! You said, ‘Call upon Me, I will answer you’ — and You do not break Your promise.
sayAdim4Merve.note1: 📍 The same supplications as at Ṣafā are repeated at Marwah.
sayAdim4Merve.note2: 🔄 When finished at Marwah, one returns toward Ṣafā.
sayAdim4Merve.note3: 🔢 Each arrival at Marwah completes one leg (shaṭṭ).
sayAdim4Merve.note4: 7️⃣ The seventh leg ends at Marwah; saʿy is completed there.
sayAdim4Merve.note5: 👩 Women do not raise their voices.

sayAdim5YediSavt.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim5YediSavt.note1: 🔢 Saʿy always starts at Ṣafā and ends at Marwah.
sayAdim5YediSavt.note2: 🏃 Men do harwalah in the green‑lit area on each leg.
sayAdim5YediSavt.note3: 🤲 At each hill, one turns toward the Kaʿbah and supplicates.
sayAdim5YediSavt.note4: ⚠️ If the leg count is uncertain, the lower count is taken.
sayAdim5YediSavt.note5: 💺 You may rest when tired; saʿy may be completed in more than one session.

sayAdim6MerveSonDua.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.bitirisDua: Allāhumma taqabbal minnā innaka Anta as-Samīʿu al-ʿAlīm
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.bitirisMeaning: O Allah! Accept this from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.vedaDua: Rabbanā ātinā fī ad-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāb an-nār
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.vedaMeaning: Our Lord! Grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the Fire.
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.note1: ✅ The seventh leg is completed at Marwah; saʿy ends here.

ihramAdim1Temizlik.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim1Temizlik.male3: Trim hair and beard, shorten the mustache
ihramAdim1Temizlik.male4: Use pleasant scent (forbidden after entering Ihram)
ihramAdim1Temizlik.female3: Do not use makeup or perfume (forbidden in Ihram)
ihramAdim1Temizlik.female4: If menstruating, ghusl is still taken; you may do all rites except tawaf

ihramAdim2Gusl.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim2Gusl.line4: Take water in the mouth, rinse
ihramAdim2Gusl.line6: Wash the whole body (no dry spot left)
ihramAdim2Gusl.line7: Let water reach the roots of the hair

ihramAdim3Elbise.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim3Elbise.male2: One lower garment: the izar is worn wrapped from the waist down.
ihramAdim3Elbise.male3: The other: the rida is draped over the shoulders.
ihramAdim3Elbise.male5: On the feet: sandals or open footwear at the heels.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female1: Normal, clean, and modest clothes are worn.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female2: The dress should not show the body’s shape.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female4: The face and hands remain visible.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female5: Ornate accessories, perfume, and eye-catching dress are avoided.

ihramAdim4Namaz.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim4Namaz.line1: Face the qibla in a state of wudūʾ
ihramAdim4Namaz.line2: Intention: “I intend to perform the Ihram prayer”
ihramAdim4Namaz.line4: In the first rak'ah: al-Fātiḥah and al-Kāfirūn,
ihramAdim4Namaz.line5: in the second: al-Fātiḥah and al-Ikhlāṣ (recommended)

ihramAdim5Niyet.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim5Niyet.line1: O Allah! I intend to perform the Hajj for Your good pleasure. Make it easy for me and accept it from me.
ihramAdim5Niyet.line2: The intention is made in the heart; saying it aloud is sunnah.

ihramAdim6Telbiye.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim6Telbiye.reading: Labbayk Allāhumma labbayk, labbayk lā sharīka laka labbayk, inna l-ḥamda wa n-niʿmata laka wa l-mulk, lā sharīka lak.
ihramAdim6Telbiye.meaning: Here I am, O Allah, here I am; here I am, You have no partner, here I am. All praise, grace, and the kingdom are Yours; You have no partner.

ihramAdim7Yasaklar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.title: 🚫 IHRĀM PROHIBITIONS
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.maleGiyim3: Wearing socks, gloves, or shoes that cover the heels
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.femaleGiyim1: Covering the face or wearing a face-veil
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.koku1: Using perfume, deodorant, or scented soap
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.kokuNote: (Unscented soap and cream may be used)
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.doga1: Plucking or cutting plants in the sacred precinct (ḥaram)
